verdict.rationale: Mastra documents a graph-based workflow engine with explicit control-flow primitives (.then(), .branch(), .parallel()) plus suspend/resume for human-in-the-loop steps, directly matching the branching/parallel/graph composition story. Community feedback is largely positive though one user reported friction with branching logic for non-LLM agents requiring custom workarounds, which tempers but doesn't contradict the documented capability. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation/example of loop constructs, and independent hands-on verification of complex nested graphs beyond the one mixed anecdote.
